companies.name: Geschenkkoerbe.ch (kommerce GmbH)
companies.distributes: Gift baskets and gift boxes with chocolate, wafers, biscuits, sweets and chips from other brands (Straumann Hueppen, Jakob's Basler Leckerly, La Perla di Torino, Choba Choba, Gottlieber, Patatas Nana), plus advent calendars
companies.channels_supplied: Own online shop to consumers and companies; corporate gifts for employees and business partners with logo personalisation
companies.fit_rationale: A national gift basket retailer whose shop has its own Schokolade und Suesses, Snacks und Chips and Suessgebaeck und Kekse categories stocked with other companies' brands, sold to over 3,000 Swiss companies. Diablo's chocolate, biscuits and gift boxes fit its employee and partner baskets. Storage: sells from its own stock with next working day delivery, warehouse not named on its website.
what_they_do_well: Says over 3,000 Swiss companies use its business gift baskets.
Member of HANDELSVERBAND.swiss with next working day delivery on orders by 18:00.

companies.name: wiant (Impact Schweiz Gruppe GmbH)
companies.distributes: Curated corporate gift boxes with chocolate, snacks, nuts, dried fruit and drinks from other brands
companies.channels_supplied: Companies buying employee and client gift boxes, shipped to offices or private addresses across Switzerland
companies.fit_rationale: A corporate gift box company built around better-for-you brainfood snacks and chocolate from Swiss brands and food startups, which matches Diablo's health-conscious positioning. Its permanent suppliers are Swiss brands and it considers other products on request. Storage: assembles and ships the boxes itself, warehouse not named on its website.
what_they_do_well: Says it has sent over 50,000 boxes for more than 150 companies.
Handles selection, packing and delivery end to end for corporate clients.

companies.name: Rose Betriebsverpflegung AG
companies.distributes: Chocolate bars (Snickers, Bounty, Kinder Bueno, Kaegi-Fret, Pick Up), biscuits (Kambly, Spitzbueb), cakes, cookies, cereal and protein bars (Balisto, Barebells), chewing gum (Mentos), crisps and nuts in workplace vending machines
companies.channels_supplied: Workplace vending and food machines: over 1,000 refreshment points for about 450 company customers, with sales teams for western and eastern Switzerland
companies.fit_rationale: Its filling product order list shows around 150 items in which branded chocolate bars, biscuits, cakes and bars outnumber coffee, all sold as they are to employees. It curates the range per site and already lists better-for-you bars. Storage: sells from its own stock with its own logistics team and route planning, warehouse not named on its website.
what_they_do_well: Family business with about 35 staff serving over 1,000 refreshment points for around 450 customers.
Calls itself the Swiss market leader in premium workplace catering, active since 2009.

companies.name: Snack24 GmbH
companies.distributes: Chocolate bars (Snickers, Twix, KitKat, Mars, Milka), gummies (Haribo, Skittles), biscuits, wafers and cakes (Oreo, Prinzen, Mikado), protein bars, vegan snacks, crisps and drinks in vending machines
companies.channels_supplied: Snack vending machines placed at offices, warehouses and workshops, from small teams to sites with over 100 employees
companies.sf_brands_carried: Protein bars and vegan snacks in a healthy alternatives section; brands not named
companies.fit_rationale: A snack-led vending operator whose product page shows branded chocolate, gummies, biscuits, wafers and healthy bars, with a range put together for each company. Its healthy alternatives shelf suits Diablo's bars and cookies. Storage: fills its own machines from its own stock, warehouse not named on its website.
what_they_do_well: Offers a separate healthy alternatives range of protein bars, rice cakes and vegan snacks for staff.

companies.name: OH MY BOX KLG
companies.distributes: Snack boxes and gift boxes filled with branded chocolate, sweets and biscuits (Lindt, Kinder, Haribo, M&M's, Knoppers, Smarties, Nutella), including a protein snack box
companies.channels_supplied: Its own online shop with delivery across Switzerland, and custom boxes for companies to give to staff and clients
companies.fit_rationale: It buys other companies' branded sweets, chocolate and biscuits and packs them into snack and gift boxes for shoppers and for companies' staff. Diablo's chocolate, sweets and gift boxes fit its boxes, and a protein box shows a health-minded line. Storage: ships every box from its own warehouse (Lager), named on its About page.
what_they_do_well: Builds custom company gift boxes with logo and greeting card, shipped direct to employees.

companies.name: Snack That GmbH
companies.distributes: Healthy sweet and savoury snacks, granola bars, drinks and meals in vending machines
companies.channels_supplied: Healthy snack vending machines at companies, schools, hospitals and gyms; free of rent from 250 users per site
companies.sf_brands_carried: Healthy snacks range; brands not named on its website
companies.fit_rationale: A healthy snack vending operator that fills and maintains its own machines with a sweet category and granola bars, aimed at health-conscious staff. Product brands are not named on its website. Storage: fills its machines from its own stock, warehouse not named on its website.

companies.name: Vending Service AG
companies.distributes: Snacks for its snack machines (a snacks section in its product range), cold drinks and coffee
companies.channels_supplied: Workplace snack, drink and coffee machines across Switzerland from 10 branches (Aarau, Basel, Bern, Geneva, Lausanne, Lucerne, Neuchatel, Solothurn, Zug, Zurich)
companies.fit_rationale: A national vending operator with about 160 staff whose teams fill, service and clean its snack machines, with snacks as the largest section of its product range. The snack brands it stocks are not named on its website. Storage: sells fill products from its own stock through 10 branches, warehouse not named on its website.
what_they_do_well: Trading in Switzerland since 1991 with about 160 employees.
Runs 10 branches covering German and French speaking Switzerland.

companies.name: Grab&Go Luzern
companies.distributes: Chocolate, gummies and jelly sweets, hard sweets, lollies, chewing gum, biscuits and bars from other brands (Haribo, Trolli, Oreo, Milka, Snickers, Reese's, Eti, Kinder) plus savoury snacks and drinks
companies.channels_supplied: Snack and drink vending machines placed with companies, offices, schools and waiting areas; its own shop in Lucerne; its online shop; resale to retailers and wholesalers
companies.sf_brands_carried: Sugar-free Fisherman's Friend, Vivil, Orbit and Sweetie People Sugar Free Mega Mix; protein brands Grenade, PowerBar and Lenny & Larry's
companies.fit_rationale: Supplies custom snack and drink vending machines to businesses and schools and sells a wide branded sweets range through its own shop and online shop. It already stocks sugar-free sweets and protein bars, so Diablo chocolate, gummies and biscuits match its customers. Storage: sells from its own stock, warehouse not named on its website.
what_they_do_well: Stocks well over 100 confectionery brands across sweets, chocolate, biscuits and bars.
Supplies private customers, retailers and wholesalers with no minimum order value.

companies.name: Tout-O-Mat
companies.distributes: Snacks and chocolate (Malteser and Ragusa shown) in its cold drink and snack machines and automatic shops, plus hot drinks and fresh products
companies.channels_supplied: Vending machines and automatic shops in workplaces, shops and clinics in French speaking Switzerland
companies.fit_rationale: A family-run vending operator founded in 1973 that runs snack machines and automatic shops for workplaces and clinics. It is listed at tier 3 because its website shows snack brands only in images and gives no fleet size.
what_they_do_well: Joined the European Vending and Coffee Service Association in August 2023.
